summary: Foremost Clean Energy filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing the closing of a transaction with Denison Mines Corp. on November 3, 2026: Foremost sold a 31% interest in the GR and Blackwing uranium properties (16 claims, 78,585 hectares; 3 claims, 12,627 hectares) in the Athabasca Basin, forming two exploration joint ventures in which Foremost retains a 20% interest and Denison holds 80%. Foremost received $650,000 cash plus issuance of 1,031,191 five-year warrants struck at $1.80, a premium exceeding 175% to the October 22, 2026 close, the announcement date. Denison funds its 80% share and has committed to geophysical studies or deficiency deposits; a six-month grace period applies to initial JV expenditures. Proceeds are earmarked largely for the Turkey Lake exploration program. Watch warrant overhang at $1.80 and Denison's earn-in progression.
